Backup & Restore

Everything is stored only in this browser. Back up regularly so a cleared cache or a new machine doesn't cost you the roster and check-in history.

Make Backups on the main computer. Restore here replaces the main computer's nets with the backup.

If this program has earned a permanent place in your shack and you would like to, you can support it at Buy Me a Coffee.

Settings

Net Profile

Each net profile has its own Roster, check-in history, and settings — use this to run multiple nets (e.g. a daily net and a weekly net) from the same app without mixing their rosters.

Net Type

Roll Call Net is the standard roster roll call (Main, Early Check-ins, End of the List, Birthdays & Anniversaries, Traffic). Traffic Net simplifies this: Birthdays & Anniversaries, Traffic, and End of the List are hidden, and Early Check-ins becomes the main screen with Callsign, Name, State, and the traffic each station is holding.

Traffic Groups

The areas, regions, or states this net sorts stations into, and logs traffic to — e.g. EAN, R5, R9, R10, WAN for an Area net, or one group per state for a single-region net. Each station is placed automatically from its roster State (checked first), then Region, then Area. "Matches" can list several values separated by commas (e.g. IA, NE, MO). With no groups, Main uses a single QTC and Destination field instead.

Net Info

Preamble Script

Display

High Visibility uses pure black with bright yellow accents for maximum contrast — handy in bright shack lighting or for low-vision readability.

UTC Time is always shown in 24-hour format regardless of this setting.

Uncheck to hide the ID Timer box entirely. Any running countdown is stopped and no reminder pop-up or beep will occur.

Weather

Weather tiles at the top of the screen, between the net name and NCS. Set separately for each net. Refreshed every 5 minutes; tiles dim when the reading is out of date. Installed app only.

File Locations

Choose where Backups and Roster exports are saved. If no folder is chosen, files go to your browser's normal download location. These folder choices apply to this browser/computer (not to individual nets).

Browser default
Browser default

For privacy, browsers only reveal the folder's name, not its full path. Your browser may ask you to allow access again the next time you open the app.

QRZ.com Login

Used to look up stations on QRZ.com, such as their photos. Photos need an active QRZ XML Logbook Data subscription. Your login is saved only on this computer, in the app's settings folder; it isn't included in Backups and applies to all nets.

Sharing

Let a tablet, phone, or laptop on your network (or Tailscale) work on this computer's nets. On that device, open one of the addresses below in a web browser, or use Connect in the Net Logger app there, and enter the pairing code. Whichever device you're using is in charge; the others follow along within a couple of seconds. This computer must be on with Net Logger open.

Tailscale addresses start with 100. You can also use this computer's Tailscale name.

On Windows, allow Net Logger through the firewall if asked (Private networks).

Use another computer's nets: enter the address shown in that computer's Settings → Sharing.

You're working on the nets of the computer at . Changes here are saved there. QRZ and weather use that computer's logins.

Roster

Callsign is split automatically into prefix / suffix for sorting (e.g. W1AW → prefix "W1", suffix "AW"; AE5EI → prefix "AE5", suffix "EI"). The roster list is always kept sorted by suffix.

Import a CSV to add or update stations in bulk. Recognized columns (any order, case-insensitive): Callsign, Name, Last Name, Spouse, City, Location, State, URL, Birthday, Anniversary, Last Check-in, Inactive (Yes/No), Area, Region, Phone, Email, Street, ZIP, Notes. A First column fills Name when there's no Name column. Rows matching an existing callsign update that entry (a blank cell leaves that field as it was); other rows are added as new stations. Birthday and Anniversary accept partial info — a bare year (e.g. "1984") or just month/day (e.g. "1/4") — as well as full dates; a value with only a year won't trigger the Birthdays & Anniversaries tab since the day isn't known.
